desc_en: Elevate your daily routine with these men's canvas mocasins. Designed for versatility and a clean aesthetic, they combine a relaxed profile with a flat EVA sole that ensures continuous support and comfort. The instep features a lacing system and a rounded toe silhouette that facilitates everyday wear. Limited pieces crafted made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Eleva tu rutina diaria con estos mocasines de lona para hombre. Diseñados para ofrecer versatilidad y una estética limpia, combinan un perfil relajado con una suela plana de EVA que garantiza soporte y comodidad continuos. El empeine cuenta con un sistema de cordones y una silueta de punta redonda que facilita el uso diario. Piezas limitadas elaboradas bajo demanda con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Crafted from canvas material.
· Durable EVA sole with 1-inch flat heel.
· Round toe design and lacing instep style.
· Made specially to order.
· Worldwide shipping available.
